projects.name: Crypto Custodian
projects.description: Freelance Lead Engineer for a licensed Indonesian crypto exchange's custody platform: built the backend that moves and settles digital assets across every registered exchange in the country.
highlights: Exchange settlement was bottlenecked at ~800 RPS with 400ms p99 latency, risking missed windows during volatility spikes: re-architected the hot-path as Go microservices on GCP, cutting p99 to 90ms and raising throughput to 5,000+ RPS (6.2x) without adding nodes.

Manual reconciliation between custody wallets and exchange ledgers drifted daily, forcing hours of manual fix: built an idempotent Node.js reconciliation service that closed 99.98% of discrepancies automatically within 2 minutes of settlement.

Next.js operator console couldn't surface real-time risk during outages: delivered a live dashboard consuming the microservice event stream, reducing mean time-to-detect incidents from 15 min to under 90 sec.

Tight latency budget across all Indonesian exchanges was breaking under concurrent load: introduced a connection-pooling + gRPC layer (Next.js to Go) that held p99 under 100ms at peak 5,000 RPS across 10+ integrated endpoints.
Stack: NextJS, Golang, Node.js, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), microservices architecture.

projects.name: Binary Tree Digital Business
projects.description: Fullstack developer for a digital business platform (client under NDA): built the genealogy and commission engine where leaders enroll downlines and earn from their sales.
highlights: Manual downline tracking could not prove a member's placement or bonus eligibility: built an advanced binary tree that classifies every node as a Profit Branch or Power Branch, validating structure in real time.

Leader bonus relied on spreadsheet reconciliation that broke above 10k members: implemented the tree traversal so any downline sale automatically cascades the correct bonus up the upline, removing manual payout.
Ten distinct bonus programs each had unique qualifying logic: modeled them as pluggable rule modules sharing one genealogy core, cutting new-bonus delivery from weeks to days.
Bonus miscalculation disputes spiked during payout runs: added an audit trail per node so every payout traces to the exact branch rule and sale that triggered it.
Stack: PHP, Laravel, MySQL, binary tree data structure, rule-based commission engine.
